scripts.build: npm run build -w @iptvmaster/core && npm run build -w @iptvmaster/api && npm run build -w @iptvmaster/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @iptvmaster/core && concurrently -n core,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @iptvmaster/core" "npm run dev -w @iptvmaster/api" "npm run dev -w @iptvmaster/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @iptvmaster/core && npm run test -w @iptvmaster/core && npm run test -w @iptvmaster/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @iptvmaster/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run verify:version && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
